rec.name: Social Proof Banner (Avatars + Customer Count)
rec.status: Built — live on PDP and bundle builder

what.text: A compact banner block on the product page showing small round customer or ambassador avatars next to a short social-proof line, e.g. "Max, Lev and 63,000 others are thrilled with us". It can be added to standard PDPs and to the Bundle Builder template. A desktop variant shows a larger line with a verified badge, e.g. "Maximilian Mittelstädt, Alphonso Davies ✓ 150,000+ others wear our products". Related: a thin trust strip above the title reading "20,000+ customers have rated us 5 stars".

why.text: Showing recognisable faces and a large customer number applies the bandwagon effect and authority/celebrity endorsement. It reassures hesitant first-time buyers near the price and title, at the point of decision. The verified tick adds credibility.

how.text: Build it as a theme-editor block ("Social proof banner") that can be added to the product template or the Bundle Builder template. In the editor, add it under the template, then set the type, colours, margin, corner style and avatar images. Place it between the price/title and the review stars. If a different position is needed, a developer must move the Liquid render. The configuration is explained in a Loom video (not available here).

dependencies.text: Needs a theme with block support (Sectionfy-based theme in the screenshot) and uploaded avatar images. The Bundle Builder template must have the block enabled. Whether the text is a metafield or a block setting is unclear. A separate rating-summary strip ("20,000+ customers… 5 stars") appears to be a different element.
